column1: # Mistakes of Kaxus's Polish translation, corrected when the pack is extracted, before the text is checked
# (engine/language/language_corrections.c). A row: the game (ages, seasons), the texts (TX_GGII, four hexadecimal digits
# each, or a range first-last, space-separated), the language (pl), a word or a phrase as the text writes it, what it
# should be, and why. Both are written in config/language_own.tsv's syntax, in the Polish ROM's letters: ASCII and
# ą ć ę ś ł ń ó ż ź in UTF-8, \n a line break, \stop the end of a box, \col(N) a colour, \\ a backslash, \xNN any other
# byte; a phrase may so run over a line break or a colour, and its correction break the line again. Every occurrence is
# replaced, a whole word where it starts or ends with a letter, the rows in their order; the text must then fit its
# lines and keep the US text's commands, else it stays in English. Only the words and their correction: the texts
# themselves stay in the user's Polish ROM.
